prompt.text:
Implement a standard-library-only declarative macro in `solution.rs` that defines record types and exposes their field names.

Export a macro named `define_record!` accepting declarations in this form:

```rust
define_record! {
    #[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
    pub struct Example {
        first: u32,
        label: String,
    }
}
```

The macro must accept zero or more outer attributes, any struct visibility, a non-generic struct name, and zero or more fields. Each field may have its own visibility and type, and a trailing comma is optional. It must emit the requested struct unchanged and an inherent public function with this signature:

```rust
pub fn field_names() -> &'static [&'static str];
```

`field_names` must return field identifiers in declaration order. An empty struct must return an empty slice. The macro must not generate constructors, mutate field values, or depend on external crates.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
